Cc: samir.khan@heliocloud.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: COI and onboarding delivery options for Redwood

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the call this morning. We're ready to provide the certificate of insurance (COI) and W-9, but wanted to confirm the easiest way for Redwood to accept them. We can: 1) upload to your vendor portal, 2) drop them on an SFTP endpoint, or 3) send via DocuSign/secure email.

Attached are the current COI and W-9 for your review (HelioCloud_COI.pdf, HelioCloud_W9.pdf). We also included a short SFTP instructions file in case you want file-push.

A couple of questions from our side so we can complete vendor setup on our side:
- What name should appear on the PO?
- Do you require an additional insured endorsement on the COI?
- Is there a preferred PO ack turnaround once we upload evidence?

Looping in Samir (accounts) for payment terms discussion.

Best,
Samir Khan
Procurement Manager
HelioCloud

Attachments: HelioCloud_COI.pdf (PDF), HelioCloud_W9.pdf (PDF), sftp-delivery-instructions.txt (text)

From: lukas.meyer@redwood.ai

Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: COI and onboarding delivery options for Redwood

Samir / team — thanks for sending these over and for the quick sync. A few notes and requests to speed activation: 

1) Preferred delivery: SFTP is fine if you can push files; we have an SFTP dropbox with inbound PGP available. If you prefer portal upload, we can send an invite link to your procurement inbox. DocuSign is only required for signature workflows — not necessary for COI/W-9.

2) PO name & billing: Please have the PO made out to Redwood Inference, Inc. Billing email should be accounts-payable@redwood.ai. For tax purposes, use Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: XX-XXXXXXX) — we will include the formal PO number in the issuance.

3) Additional insured: For network-services vendors we normally require a general liability endorsement naming Redwood Inference as additional insured. Can you confirm if your insurer can add: Redwood Inference, Inc., 1120 Market St, San Francisco, CA? If not, we can discuss conditional PO with procurement.

4) Timing: If documents arrive by end-of-day Wednesday (2027-01-20), procurement aims to issue a conditional PO within 48 hours, pending endorsement confirmation.

Cc'ing Priyom (procure ops) and Kimberly (risk) to note the endorsement requirement. If you prefer, we can accept the current COI for now and add endorsement as a follow-up requirement with a 30-day remediation window.

Thanks — Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
